edm.note: Electronic dance. MMA has no EDM groove; ElectricPop and Rave are the other candidates.

pop.note: Stdlib has PopBallad, not a straight pop beat.

hiphop.note: Written as hip-hop. casio/hip-hop:Hip-Hop is the keyboard conversion.

classical.note: MMA has no classical groove. Sustained strings are the nearest 4/4 pattern.

soundtrack.note: MMA has no cinematic groove. A piano ballad stands in for underscore.

metal.note: Keyboard metal. pflib/metal1:metal1A is a sectional pattern and a poor default.

reggae.note: MMA has no reggae file. Ska is the off-beat neighbor.

world.note: World has no single MMA style. This is the percussion-heavy pop pattern.

lofi.note: Closest chill electronic pattern. It is not lo-fi jazz.

indie.note: MMA has no indie groove. Folk-rock is the nearest 4/4 band.

punk.note: MMA has no punk groove. This is the loud straight rock pattern.
